summary: Careful, well‑documented preregistered paired study comparing a verifier‑assisted vs. LLM‑only pre‑deployment workflow. Execution and analysis artifacts are archived and consistent with the reported results: baseline 299/300 unflagged passes, guarded 300/300, paired difference 0.00333, exact McNemar two‑sided p=1.0. The manuscript appropriately discusses limitations (ceiling effect, single model/validator, synthetic suite) and includes the required Disclosure Statement. Required clarifications remain before finalisation.
critical_issues: Manuscript does not include a concise human‑readable excerpt of the archived low‑level repair transcript or an explicit pointer (artifact path + short excerpt) sufficient for readers to assess the single automated repair that yielded the lone discordant rescue.

The reported inferential result (exact McNemar two‑sided p = 1.0) is counterintuitive; the manuscript needs a brief, explicit explanation of the exact test used and why p=1.0 follows from the observed discordant counts (n10=1,n01=0) so readers are not misled about interpretation.

Although discussed, the conditional nature of the shared_initial estimand (one shared LLM candidate per pair) should be stated more prominently in Methods (first paragraph) and in the Abstract as a limitation so readers correctly interpret the scope of inference.
required_revisions: Insert into the manuscript a concise, human‑readable excerpt of the archived low‑level repair provider trace for the single guarded rescue (or an explicit artifact path plus a short verbatim/redacted excerpt no longer than a few sentences) so reviewers/readers can verify the semantic nature of the repair; this change can be satisfied from existing archived artifacts referenced in the execution manifest.

Add a short clarification (Methods or Results) explaining the exact two‑sided McNemar/equivalent test implementation used by paired_binary_analysis_v1 and explicitly state why with discordant counts n10=1,n01=0 the two‑sided p returns 1.0 and how this affects interpretability of the confirmatory test.

Prominently (Methods and Abstract) state that the primary estimand is conditional on a single shared_initial LLM generation per pair (shared_initial protocol) and explicitly note how this conditioning affects external interpretation (i.e., this measures verifier+repair effect conditional on an identical candidate, not end‑to‑end independent draws).
optional_revisions: Consider including a 1–2 sentence concrete example (task id and short intent) illustrating how the validator's workflow policy triggered the repair to aid reader intuition (can be drawn from archived task_manifest entries).
Condense provenance bookkeeping sentences where possible to free space and improve narrative flow (while keeping full disclosure intact).
Explicitly state the exact artifact paths and hashes for the archived repair trace in Results or an appendix note to ease artifact inspection by reviewers/readers.
